tips.text: Latch onto a wall, or aim-glide, during Oraxia's scuttler phases; none of the Scuttlers reach you.
Hold crouch for Operator Void Mode; it is total immunity in the scuttler phases and lets you revive squadmates.
Check the rolled loadout before you launch and run Steel Path only if the spiral handed you gear you have built.
Run Isleweaver until you hold 120 husks, buy what is missing from Acrithis, and only then farm the Duviri plants.
Run one Circuit stage and bail, or finish and abort an Isleweaver run, to reroll a bad frame and weapon set.
Avoid touching Death Scuttlers; contact cancels channeled abilities and their ground blast punishes armor and invisibility setups.
Use the Exalted weapons of Titania, Hildryn or Jade against The Fragmented if the spiral rolls them.
Skip pizzas, scanners and companions; Isleweaver has no Gear wheel and Q summons your Kaithe.
Subsume Silence to stop Oraxia wall-jumping so you can melee her on the floor.
Check your enemy levels on the first tile; Steel Path queues have landed in normal and the reverse.
Expect a few hours end to end; players hold her pity shop up as how acquisition should work.
Expect the Duviri resource step, Tasoma Extract above all, to be the only real complaint.
